chunks: Did We not give him two eyes?

key_terms.نَجْعَل: to make, to give, to bestow

ai.seo_question: What physical blessing does Surah Al-Balad mention regarding human creation?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Balad, this verse underscores the divine endowment of vision as a fundamental capacity for moral discernment and accountability. Shia exegetes often interpret this physical blessing as a prerequisite for recognizing the path of righteousness, linking the ability to see with the spiritual insight required to navigate the trials of the city (Makkah).
